thread:
devin: rough draft idea  add an "explainability pill" in the request list when fallback happens. small text: 'fell back (graded): latency -> why' and an arrow to details. thoughts?

maria: i like the graded wording. operators often want a quick signal: was it transient latency, sustained error rate, or safety filter? we should show a two-letter code + color.

sam: agree. propose 'graded' levels: green=transient, amber=persistent, red=immediate. also capture a short metric snippet like 'p95=1.2s -> 5.6s at trigger'.

devin: UX: pill expands to timeline + small histogram and a link to the sampled trace. add a "re-run against primary" button for replay (gated).
olivia: very useful for postmortems. add an operator-only checkbox "show raw primary output" behind RBAC. default off.

ops-bot: rollout-note: explainable_fallback_pill flag enabled for 10% orgs

maria: telemetry: emit fallback_explainability: {grade, trigger_type, ms_at_trigger, p95_before, p95_after, sampled_trace_id}. sampling configurable per org.
sam: audit plan: store hashed outputs + sample id for 120d. store K-anonymized traces for privacy. UI replay uses ephemeral unredacted view requiring SSO reauth.
devin: API: add header X-Redwood-Fallback-Info: grade=amber;trigger=latency;trace=trc_77 and optional ?debug=fallback_meta in body for authorized clients.

olivia: also surface quota interplay: if fallback caused by quota exhaustion on primary (rare), label as 'quota' and show org quota link.
maria: good call. we'll include cause=quota in trigger_type enum.
sam: tests: unit for header format + E2E that simulates quota saturation and latency spike; verify pill renders and re-run is gated.
devin: defaults: sampling 0.05% org-wide, 2% for experiment cohort. ops-bot please set flags.

ops-bot: set sampling_rate=0.05% / cohort=2% (tag: explainable_fallback_expt)

maria: followups: i will draft tooltip copy (short + long), telemetry schema PR, RBAC matrix for raw-view, and runbook snippet for graded meanings.
sam: i'll add unit + e2e tests and the replay gating flow.
devin: i'll mock the pill and timeline and drop images in the PR. thanks all.
